summary: New Era Energy & Digital, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026, disclosing entry into an At-The-Market Issuance Sales Agreement with Mizuho, B. Riley, Northland, Texas Capital Securities, BTIG and Roth Capital as agents for an ATM program of up to $100 million of common stock. Shares issue under an existing Form S-3 shelf declared effective January 30, 2026; agents receive up to 3.5% commission and reimbursement. This is an ordinary shelf takedown facility, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and Nasdaq pricing limits.
